_about: In-world tasks. Real-life ones are never here — each app writes its own to ~/.linggen/quests/<app>.json. A hosted game costs rewards.json stamina.cost.game when it is paid (论道 when it opens) and pays from the `game` table: a little, every day — the card fight is where 修为 is earned. A story board may be left once the player is stuck (「算了，往下走」, rules/skips.mjs): a skip pays NOTHING of `grant` (no 修为, 灵石, item), writes no grade or mark, and the story goes on; what the story itself needs from a board goes in `gives` (handed over even on a skip), never in `grant`. A board left comes back by itself on a later day, offered with its `replay` line (else one made from its title); won then, it pays in full.
